text:
Ishaan: Question: who left the giant inflatable flamingo in the kitchen? It9s blocking the coffee machine and I tripped over its inflatable wing.
Priya: That was me. It was a birthday prank for Marta. Sorry about the wing hazard.
Marta: best birthday ever. Also the flamingo has now been christened 'Sir Sips-a-Lot'.
Ishaan: Sir Sips-a-Lot has a future in barista services. Also proposal: mandatory flamingo parade at 10am on Fridays.
Priya: :100: yes. I'll bring confetti.
Marta: I'll choreograph.
Deploy Bot: Reminder: deploy to staging in 20 minutes. Please be aware of any kitchen obstructions.
Ishaan: Noted. Sir Sips-a-Lot will be relocated to the conference room until after the parade.
Priya: Also attaching a photo: https://imgur.com/sir-sips-a-lot.jpg :flamingo:
Marta: Thanks team. Also can someone please remove confetti from the espresso machine if we do the parade. I love the enthusiasm.
Ishaan: Parade approved. Marching band TBD.
